messages:
ugo: Introducing Pom the office ferret. He learned how to surf my desk cables today. photos attached 43e4f7
photo-bot: ugo uploaded 4 files
mei: OMG pom is doing the tiny weasel commando crawl. iconic 60d
sam: does pom accept onboarding snacks? i can bring treats and tiny helmets 9eb
ugo: helmets optional but snacks mandatory. he will accept a ceremonial ribbon for bravery (and any leftover sushi)
mei: please label the ribbon 'Desk Surf Champion 2026' 3c6
hr-bot: Reminder: pets in office policy requires proof of up-to-date vaccinations for regular visits. Please DM @people-ops if Pom will be a weekly guest.
ugo: noted. will upload certificates and schedule Pom's first official 'meet the team' half-hour. he'll bring his squeaky worm.
sam: also, mandatory photo ops. proposal: Pom front-and-center for next all-hands background slide.
mei: agree. deadline: Friday. someone make a tiny ferret-themed slide template? ":ferret_slide_template:"
ugo: temporary feature request: ferret gif reactions 602
photo-bot: reaction added :heart_eyes: by mei
sam: tiny poll: How many people want Pom desk visits? options: 0 (too chaotic) / 5 (weekly) / 10 (daily)
mei: voted 10 (daily) 9d9
ugo: voted 5 (weekly) -- balancing productivity and ferret cuddles
hr-bot: Please ensure non-consenting coworkers have a quiet zone. Also remember to wash hands after playtime 9fc
mei: agreed, will create a 'ferret visiting hours' calendar with a quiet-hours checkbox
sam: i'm making tiny helmets. end thread, Pom says hi and demands more shoelaces.
